memory.summary:
On January 17, 2026, Leo had a conversation with Diego at school regarding their AI project and plans to meet for street tacos regularly every Tuesday at 3 PM at Caroline's Café, with Leo bringing his violin for improvisation. Leo also had discussions and plans to meet Caroline, Andy, and Samantha at their respective meetings in the coming days. On the same day, Leo caught up with Caroline at the café, where they discussed the potential for a musical collaboration. They agreed to meet again the following day at the same time to continue their discussion and make plans.

Leo also spoke with Samantha at a town hall on the same day, where Samantha thanked him for the inspiration for her latest algorithm. Leo expressed his appreciation for Samantha's open-source libraries and shared his excitement about a bird symphony he had heard at the park that morning. Samantha suggested they continue their discussion at Caroline's Café the next day at 3 PM, and Leo agreed, planning to bring his violin to explore potential collaborations. Therefore, Leo's and Caroline's upcoming schedules now include a meeting at the café on January 18, 2026, to discuss their potential musical collaboration, and a meeting with Samantha at the same café the following day to discuss her latest work.
